name: twelvetake
description: Claude Code plugins by TwelveTake Studios.

plugins.name: content-audit
plugins.description: Audit AI-written prose for wrong claims, citations that do not support their sentence, sentences copied from the source, and generated voice.

plugins.name: ratchet
plugins.description: Ratcheting checks that fail when a file gains descriptive code comments or a document gains figures with no stated source.

plugins.name: required-reading
plugins.description: Block commands and edits in a risky area until the named runbooks and checklists have been read in full this session.

plugins.name: audit-hygiene
plugins.description: A register of findings already ruled on, checked before any audit reports, and a procedure for proving a check can fail.

plugins.name: found-bugs
plugins.description: Claude fixes or specifically reports every bug it comes across, never removes a feature to make a bug go away, and a Stop hook sends it back when it does either.
